description: 西西里飞龙B70 — 关键时机：换象消灭防守子后赢马

intro.popup_en:
Key Timing, Practice 7: Sicilian Dragon
Black's bishop on g7 is powerful. Can ...Na5 force White's knight away so ...Bc4 can attack Bd3 and win the knight on b3? Track the timing chain.
intro.popup:
关键时机练习7

西西里飞龙！

Bg7是强力对角线象
Na5逼马后Bc4如何赢子？

练习目标：
识别Bc4→Bxd3→Nxb3的时机链

outro.popup_en: The four-step combination: ...Na5 drives the knight from b3; ...Bc4 attacks Bd3 and forces an exchange; ...Bxd3 removes the bishop defending Nb3; then ...Nxb3 wins the knight. The bishop exchange is valuable because it removes the defender.
outro.popup:
飞龙时机总结

四步赢马链：
① Na5：逼白方Nb3退
② Bc4！：攻击d3迫换象
③ Bxd3：消灭Be3保护者
④ Nxb3！：赢得白方马！

换象是为了清除防守子！

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 recaptures and centralizes the knight.
Nc3 develops and supports the center.
Nb3 develops and clears the c-pawn's route.
...Be6 maneuvers the bishop and prepares the tactical sequence.
...Na5! The knight attacks and drives the white knight from b3.

moves.popup:
Bc4！时机！
攻击d3格，迫使白方换象
moves.popup_en: ...Bc4! The timing is right: the bishop attacks d3 and forces White to exchange.
Bd3 is forced to defend the position.
...Bxd3! Black removes Be3, the defender of the knight on b3.

moves.popup:
Nxb3！赢得白方马！
时机连锁完成
moves.popup_en: ...Nxb3! Black wins the knight. The timing sequence is complete.

moves.popup: axb3 黑方已获材料优势
moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures, but Black has won material.
